title: Hot Honey Cheddar Chilli Crisp Eggs
intro: Crispy cheese skirt, runny yolks, sweet heat on top. 10 minutes, one pan.
method: Scatter the cheddar into a thin round, a little bigger than two eggs, in a dry non-stick pan on medium heat. Let it melt and crisp at the edges, 1–2 minutes.
Drizzle the hot honey over the cheese.
Crack both eggs straight onto the cheese and season.
Cook till the whites are set and the edges of the cheese are golden and crisp. Keep the yolks runny.
Spoon the chilli crisp over the eggs.
Fold the whole thing over like an omelette (the cheese skirt holds it together) and slide onto a plate.
Dip toast straight into the yolk.
tips: Cheese first, dry pan, no oil. It fries in its own fat and turns into the crispy skirt.
15 g is all you need. More cheese and it goes greasy instead of crisp.
No hot honey? Honey plus a pinch of chilli flakes, warmed for 10 seconds.
